hotspots.title: Trump administration advances major arms sales amidst regional tensions
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration has approved a massive $24.3 billion sale of F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia, while a top Democrat placed a hold on a $2.8 billion weapons sale to Israel, reflecting heightened geopolitical and domestic contention over military aid.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the immense financial value, the implications for escalating regional conflicts, and direct political opposition.
